name: Amsonia

project_scope.selection_mode: Two canonical species and one Master Pool infraspecific source name; no canonical installation
project_scope.note: Var. texana is a source-pool infraspecific concept under A. ciliata, not a third canonical species. Both installed species retain RANGE_UNRESOLVED and are excluded from confirmed target-zone native counts.

look_here_first: LOOK HERE FIRST: turn one intact flower SIDE-ON and measure the narrow fused corolla tube from its base to the spreading lobes. A. ciliata is reported at 6–9(–10) mm; A. longiflora at (20–)28–41(–45) mm. A flower face alone cannot prove tube length. Then compare sepals, leaf margins and mature paired follicles.
shared_genus_traits: Perennial herbs with simple narrow leaves and clusters of five-lobed salverform flowers: a narrow fused tube opening into spreading lobes.
The flower center has ordinary stamens, unlike the milkweed corona hoods and gynostegium of Asclepias; milkweed specialization is not universal across Apocynaceae.
Sepals surround the base of the corolla tube; leaf nodes and margins offer secondary vegetative context, but blue/white petal color is not diagnostic.
Fruits are typically paired slender follicles that split along one side; obtain an attached mature pair rather than interpreting an isolated seed.

quick_key.if: Intact flower side view has a fused tube approximately 6–10 mm long
quick_key.then: Amsonia ciliata (species-level only; do not infer var. texana)

quick_key.if: Intact flower side view has a fused tube approximately 20–45 mm long, typically 28–41 mm
Only a frontal flower photo, cultivated mass planting, or immature/damaged corolla is available
quick_key.then: Do not force species; obtain side view with ruler and calyx in focus.

genus_diagnostics.look_here_first: Flower side view → measure corolla tube → locate calyx/sepals → compare nodes and leaf margins → follow to mature paired follicles.

shared_structure_examples.plain: Five petal-like lobes spread from the top of a single narrow fused flower tube.
shared_structure_examples.photo_role: paired whole flower side views and front views
shared_structure_examples.where_to_look: Follow the narrow tube from green calyx to where the lobes spread.
shared_structure_examples.why: Shared genus shape; the TUBE LENGTH is the best species split.

shared_structure_examples.plain: The skinny lower part of the fused petals, not the flower stalk.
shared_structure_examples.photo_role: same-scale side views with millimeter ruler
shared_structure_examples.where_to_look: Measure from the tube base at calyx to the beginning of the five spreading lobes.
shared_structure_examples.why: Short 6–10 mm in ciliata versus much longer 20–45 mm in longiflora.

shared_structure_examples.plain: The small green outer cup and its pointed lobes at the base of the flower.
shared_structure_examples.photo_role: side-on flower base macro with tube and individual sepal
shared_structure_examples.where_to_look: Inspect where the flower tube meets its stalk; do not count white corolla lobes as sepals.
shared_structure_examples.why: Supports structural confirmation and future regional-key comparison.

shared_structure_examples.plain: Two long narrow dry seed pods that can open down one side.
shared_structure_examples.photo_role: attached mature paired follicles and one open follicle
shared_structure_examples.where_to_look: Trace fruit to its flowering stem and document both carpels.
shared_structure_examples.why: Recognize broad dogbane fruit without assuming milkweed hoods or pollinaria.

teaching_order: Locate an open intact flower and its green calyx.
Turn flower side-on and measure the fused tube in millimeters; do not measure the pedicel.
Compare flower front to learn five lobes but do not key species from this perspective alone.
Inspect leaf nodes and margins as supporting evidence, not var. texana proof.
When mature, examine paired slender follicles; compare ordinary bluestar stamens with specialized milkweed gynostegium.
study_strategy.warning: The two installed exact-species images show flowering habit and flower faces but do not resolve a ruler-calibrated side-on tube. Range status is separate from learner admission.

comparison_cards.title: Tube length — the real species split
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Measure the entire fused tube on multiple intact flowers: 6–9(–10) mm in ciliata versus (20–)28–41(–45) mm in longiflora.
photo_requirements: Matched side-on flowers for both species, green calyx to corolla-lobe junction visible, millimeter ruler
comparison_cards.caution: Neither installed image can establish the actual length; verify the published ranges in Taxonomy + Diagnostic Review before using strict exclusions.

comparison_cards.title: Front view is a trap
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Both have five spreading lobes; a pretty face-on flower picture hides the long or short tube.
photo_requirements: Same flower photographed front-on AND side-on for each species
comparison_cards.caution: Petal color and lobe spread overlap; the existing longiflora flower photo is useful for genus recognition, not tube measurement.

comparison_cards.title: Bluestar versus milkweed
comparison_cards.look_here_first: Find ordinary stamens inside a salverform Amsonia corolla; compare with Asclepias corona hoods, gynostegium and pollinaria.
photo_requirements: Rights-cleared Amsonia flower-center macro plus one labeled Asclepias flower-center macro
comparison_cards.caution: Latex and paired follicles can occur in broader Apocynaceae; do not claim all dogbanes have milkweed hoods.

local_lookalikes.difference: Master Pool infraspecific name, not a third canonical card. Species-level photos do not prove the variety; route to Taxonomy + Diagnostic Review.
Additional bluestar comparison name from canonical species records. Verify regional occurrence and flower-tube/calyx metrics before keying it; do not treat as installed.
Milkweed corona hoods and fused gynostegium differ from Amsonia's ordinary salverform flower and stamens; paired follicles alone are not decisive.

diagnostic_photo_checklist.need: Equal-scale exact-species flower side views with calyx, entire tube, lobe junction and mm ruler; strongest separating feature.
Side-on sepal length and tube-base images, scale included; no unverified arrows.
Matched attached leaf-node and margin hair views; do not assert var. texana.
Attached paired fruits plus one opening follicle, species identity and creator/license verified.
